title: The Stadium
content: I visited last night. I’d been there before but, it’s been a long time. I hope I don’t go back for a long while again. I don’t know what to call it other than a stadium. I’m hoping someone else has been there too. There’s no rhyme or reason to be there. You think you’re walking on a normal street but, you’re actually on a track. Have you ever been looking at your feet while taking a stroll, look up, and been disoriented? “When did I miss my turn?” Exactly like that. It’s oblong but, despite the distance, you can see others walking on the other side. The track is extremely wide. There are these buildings, all black, every so often. They house box seats, concessions, and bathrooms. You can continue your path around the box, a lot of NPC do. There appears to be a second floor but, no access. It looks like where the good seats are. Despite the openness of the track and the glass in the box; I’ve never seen what’s in the middle. A pit? A football field? A sandworm? Last night there was a bit of fog. That’s the catch. That’s why I hate to be there. Even when I conjure myself a companion; the place turns ugly. Every time I try to look over the edge, every time I try to lean out to see through the glass, every time I try to find an out; I fall through rabbit holes. If you’ve been to Mall World, you know there’s always a way to “get home” but, not from there. You’re stuck there until you can wake up. I fall through layers of my subconscious until I’m back on the track. No NPC has ever interacted with me there. Ever. Each time I’ve had to conjure myself a companion. I wind up losing them as I tumble through my mind scape. Memories twisted, warped, tangled together making a labyrinth I can’t tell up or down. Eventually I give in. I sit on a bench. I walk the track. I wave at the NPC who have their heads down. Maybe the next rabbit hole I fall down, I tread more carefully. Eventually I do wake up. Would you know what I’m talking about?
